scope: Old-cohort rendezvous, prepared slots and global-reader ordering for grow/shrink/no-op count publication; not physical C refinement or full GC/VM lifetime.

cases.scope: A bounded three-slot topology, one global registry reader and one count writer. Root commit requires all old participants and prepared target slots. Reader lease overlaps ordinary count write in both old growth and no-op policies; the positive drains before changed publication and does not write on no-op. Global direct-pstate/VM users remain externally owned, reader and writer C operations are abstract coherent actions, and thread readiness, joins, arbitrary signal storms and multiple writer fairness are outside the bound. Composition edges state reused obligations, not imported whole-model refinement; not an attributed PR988 runtime crash.
